items.titleZh: 迈凯伦车队与Edward Jones达成多年期F1和印地赛车合作协议

items.originalTitle: McLaren Racing and Edward Jones join forces in multi-year F1 and IndyCar partnership
items.summaryEn: McLaren Racing and Edward Jones have announced a multi-year partnership naming the St. Louis-based firm as the Official Private Wealth Management Partner across both Formula 1 and IndyCar. The partnership will be activated during the 2026 Formula 1 season and expand into IndyCar in 2027.
detailZh: 迈凯伦车队与Edward Jones建立多年期F1和印地赛车合作伙伴关系
这一全新联盟连接F1与印地赛车，包括在2027年印第安纳波利斯500大赛上对斯科特·迪克森的6号Arrow 迈凯伦雪佛龙进行主赞助
在一份联合声明中，迈凯伦车队与Edward Jones宣布建立多年期合作伙伴关系，指定这家总部位于圣路易斯的公司为横跨F1和印地赛车的官方私人财富管理合作伙伴。该协议将在这两项全球赛车运动顶级平台建立长期、全年的品牌曝光。
合作将于2026年F1赛季启动，内容包括在部分分站的车手头盔护目镜上展示品牌标识，并在赛季日程中的多项重磅活动亮相。2027年，合作将拓展至印地赛车。Edward Jones将担任6号Arrow 迈凯伦雪佛龙在第111届印第安纳波利斯500大赛的主赞助商，并赞助部分其他比赛。六届印地系列赛冠军、2008年印地500冠军斯科特·迪克森已于上周宣布将在2027赛季驾驶6号赛车。
迈凯伦赛车首席执行官扎克·布朗表示：“爱德华·琼斯（Edward Jones）在服务客户和社区方面有着悠久的历史，我们很高兴欢迎他们成为迈凯伦赛车的合作伙伴。我们都秉持以人为本的文化，并共同致力于充分准备和持续改进，这使此次合作成为天作之合。”
除了赛道旁的品牌展示之外，这次合作还将聚焦于客户、社区和车迷互动，其核心是双方共同的运营价值观——充分准备、团队协作、坚韧不拔和追求卓越，并将辅以联合品牌的数字和社交媒体内容。
箭头迈凯伦总裁凯文·蒂姆琼（Kevin Thimjon）表示：“我们非常高兴能与爱德华·琼斯（Edward Jones）开启这段合作关系，欢迎他们加入箭头迈凯伦和印地赛车（IndyCar）的大家庭。随着6号车组即将在下个赛季迈入激动人心的新篇章，我们期待着让他们加入我们，并在赛车运动最盛大的舞台上并肩作战。”

爱德华·琼斯（Edward Jones）负责人兼首席品牌、体验与营销官赫玛·维德哈尼（Hema Widhani）补充道：“无论是在赛道上还是在财务规划中，成功都很少源于某一单个瞬间；相反，它是通过充分准备、自律以及长期做出的成千上万个决定累积而成的。迈凯伦赛车最让我们兴奋的，是每一场表现背后所体现的团队协作、坚韧不拔和持续改进的文化。这些也正是帮助我们的客户应对复杂局面、实现他们心中重要目标的原则。”
detailEn: McLaren Racing and Edward Jones join forces in multi-year F1 and IndyCar partnership
New alliance bridges Formula 1 and IndyCar, including primary sponsorship of Scott Dixon’s # 6 Arrow McLaren Chevrolet at the 2027 Indianapolis 500

In a joint announcement, McLaren Racing and Edward Jones revealed a new multi-year partnership designating the St. Louis–based firm as the Official Private Wealth Management Partner across both Formula 1 and IndyCar. The agreement establishes a long-term, year-round presence across two of global motorsport's premier racing platforms.

The activation begins during the 2026 Formula 1 season with driver helmet visor branding at selected races and a presence at key marquee events throughout the calendar. In 2027, the partnership will expand into IndyCar. Edward Jones will serve as the primary partner for the #6 Arrow McLaren Chevrolet at the 111th Running of the Indianapolis 500, alongside additional select races. Six-time IndyCar Series champion and 2008 Indy 500 winner Scott Dixon was announced last week as the driver for the #6 entry throughout the 2027 campaign.

“Edward Jones has a long history of supporting its clients and communities, and we’re excited to welcome them as McLaren Racing partners,” said Zak Brown, CEO, McLaren Racing. “We have a shared commitment toward preparation and continuous improvement through a peoplefirst culture, making this partnership a natural fit.”

Beyond trackside branding, the collaboration will focus on client, community, and fan engagement centered on shared operational values—preparation, teamwork, resilience, and performance – supplemented by co-branded digital and social media content.

"We’re thrilled to begin this relationship with Edward Jones and welcome them to Arrow McLaren and IndyCar racing,” said Kevin Thimjon, President, Arrow McLaren. “With the #6 crew entering an exciting new chapter next season, we look forward to bringing them on board and competing together on some of the biggest stages in motorsports.”

Hema Widhani, Principal and Chief Brand, Experience and Marketing Officer, Edward Jones, said, added, “Whether on a racetrack or in a financial plan, success is rarely the result of a single moment; instead, it’s built through preparation, discipline and thousands of decisions made over time. What excites us most about McLaren Racing is the culture of teamwork, resilience and continuous improvement behind every performance. Those are many of the same principles that help our clients navigate complexity and achieve what's important to them."

items.originalTitle: “I fear something bad is going to happen soon” – 2026 F1 cars are “too dangerous”, Sergio Perez warns
items.summaryEn: Sergio Perez has warned that he fears "something bad" might happen soon due to the speed differential between cars with Formula 1's new machinery. The topic was major early in the 2026 season, especially after Oliver Bearman's mammoth crash at the Japanese Grand Prix.
detailZh: “我担心很快会有不好的事情发生”——塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹警告2026年F1赛车“太危险”
对新一代F1引擎的担忧已基本平息，但佩雷兹仍然担心有人会受伤
塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹表示，由于F1新一代赛车之间的速度差，他担心“可能会有不好的事情发生”。
这在2026赛季初期是一个重大话题，尤其是在奥利弗·比尔曼于日本大奖赛发生严重撞车之后。这位哈斯车手在比赛中遇到较慢的弗兰科·科拉平托，采取避让动作后失去对赛车的控制。
这一事故不幸印证了人们对F1新动力单元的担忧，新动力单元有47%的电能，这使得各车之间因能量释放方式不同而产生了巨大差距。
国际汽联在4月的休赛期采取了行动来缓解这一问题，对引擎规则进行了调整，减少了松油滑行的需要，但佩雷斯透露他在巴库吓得不轻。
“最重要的是，这场比赛让我们需要好好审视能量管理方面到底发生了什么，还有引擎之间的差异，”这位凯迪拉克车手在阿塞拜疆大奖赛结束后表示。
“当我在防守[利亚姆]劳森的时候，差点就和他发生了严重撞车，因为各引擎之间在能量释放和动力上的差异实在太危险了。我担心如果我们不对规则做出一些改变，很快就会有糟糕的事情发生。”
2027年的进一步调整，包括电力占比从47%降至42%，预计将改善这一局面。
“我希望他们能够缩小差距，”佩雷斯补充道，“因为目前的感觉是，梅赛德斯和红牛的引擎非常强大，在能量释放方式与我们差异很大、而我们释放表现很差的地方，他们能轻易超过我们。速度上的差距太危险了。”
与此同时，这位墨西哥车手对接下来的巴林大奖赛（在马来西亚举行）并没有多少热情。
当有人向他提到雪邦的高速弯道可能会被2026年的F1赛车“毁掉”时，佩雷斯回应道：“我们最好别谈这个。”
detailEn: “I fear something bad is going to happen soon” – 2026 F1 cars are “too dangerous”, Sergio Perez warns
Fears over new-generation F1 engines have largely died down, but Perez is still worried someone might get hurt
Sergio Perez says he fears “something bad” might happen due to the speed differential between cars with Formula 1’s new machinery.

This was a major topic early in the 2026 season, especially after Oliver Bearman had a mammoth crash in the Japanese Grand Prix. The Haas driver lost control of his car after taking avoiding action when he encountered a slower Franco Colapinto on track during the race.
The incident unfortunately vindicated concerns about F1’s new power units, with 47% electrical energy, which creates a substantial contrast between cars depending on energy deployment.
The FIA took action during the April break to attenuate the issue, with tweaks to engine rules reducing the need for lift-and-coast tactics, but Perez has revealed he had quite a scare in Baku.
“More than anything, it's a race that we need to review a lot what's going on with the energy management, the difference on engine,” the Cadillac racer said after the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

“I was going to have a massive shunt with [Liam] Lawson when I was defending from him, because the difference in deployment and power across engines is too dangerous. And I fear something bad is going to happen soon, if we don't make some changes on the regulations.”
Further tweaks for 2027, including the proportion of electrical power dropping from 47% to 42%, are expected to improve the situation.

“I hope they are able to close up the gap,” Perez added, “because at the moment it feels like, Mercedes and Red Bull, they have a very strong engine, and they can get you in places where the deployment is so poor and different to us. The difference in speed is too dangerous.”
In the meantime, the Mexican is focusing on the upcoming Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia with little enthusiasm.
When it was suggested to him that Sepang’s high-speed corners might be ‘ruined’ with F1’s 2026 cars, Perez responded: “We better don’t talk about it.”

items.titleZh: 阿隆索决定留在F1再战一季，《The Race》给出评价
items.summaryZh: 尽管在阿斯顿·马丁与本田合作的赛季收效甚微，费尔南多·阿隆索仍签约继续征战一级方程式。《The Race》的编辑认为他不得不留下，不会以这样一个赛季告别车坛。
items.originalTitle: Our verdict on Alonso deciding to stay in F1
items.summaryEn: Despite a largely fruitless season with Aston Martin and Honda, Fernando Alonso has signed up for another Formula 1 season. The Race's writers argue he had to stay, as he would not bow out of the sport after such a season.
detailZh: 尽管在阿斯顿·马丁与本田合作的赛季收效甚微，费尔南多·阿隆索仍签约继续征战一级方程式。
但在2027年及以后，他究竟能实现什么？
他必须留下。你不会在F1坚持到四十五岁左右，却以这样一个赛季告别车坛。
那么他还会留多久？期待阿斯顿·马丁下赛季就能挑战分站冠军无异于期待奇迹。但如果发展趋势正确，性能提升显著，我能预见这会给阿隆索足够的信心将合同延至2028年。
我无法想象他内心深处真的相信另一个冠军还在他的未来之中。阿斯顿·马丁和本田在新规则实施的第一年领先所有人是唯一可能实现这一点的机会，而我一直觉得这个机会很渺茫。
现在，我认为他的目标只是再次做出一些值得铭记的事情。如果他在2023年那段巅峰期里那么多登台中哪怕赢下一场比赛，我想他现在早就离开了。只要再多一场胜利，他坚持这么久的决定就完全说得通了。
如果阿斯顿·马丁能在2027年就恢复到2023年那样的水准，我会感到意外。但如果它多少能成为逼近四大车队的竞争者，我可以想象这足以说服阿隆索在明年之后继续留下。
原则上，阿隆索留在F1显然比离开要好。但如果是为这样的局面而浪费他的才华和时间，我看不出有什么意义——所以阿斯顿·马丁和本田面临着巨大的压力，必须证明他重新做出的承诺是值得的。
当然，阿隆索的付出会得到极其丰厚的回报。所以对他的处境能给予的同情也是有限的！我只是更希望看到他在一个能争夺前列的地方比赛，用他的天赋让我们眼前一亮，因为像巴库那样的糟糕日子，对所有人来说都是一种煎熬。
但他很可能认为这值得一搏，最后一次押上骰子，尤其是他目前正处于非常有利的谈判位置。
你可以说阿斯顿·马丁并不需要他这种水准的车手，因为就目前而言，车手远不是限制车队表现的因素。所以由谁来驾驶赛车，对车队的竞争前景并没有实质性的影响。
但仅凭面子这一点，阿斯顿·马丁也会希望自己的项目挂上一个顶级名号，而在这方面阿隆索是唯一的选择。眼下没有其他车手愿意冒险加盟，所以阿隆索深知，没有人会给他带来真正争夺他席位的压力。
这意味着他可以开价等钱，并且在那里等着——如果（这是个很大的“如果”）事情真的在他最终决定受够了、转身离开之前谈成的话。
从竞技角度来看，我觉得这个结果没什么令人满意的——阿隆索留在了一支车队（以及发动机制造商）那里，而这支车队冲击前列的时间表与他的似乎错位；其整个赛季乏善可陈，车手搭档也年复一年地是一边倒的较量。2027年我们几乎不可能对阿隆索或斯特罗尔有任何新的了解，而阿隆索想要增加自己两个F1世界冠军、甚至很可能包括他的32个F1分站冠军的可能性，几乎是天文数字般的渺茫。
但除非你谈论的是掠夺性的资本积累，看到数字能涨到多高，确实有一种可以理解的满足感。440场起步——那为何不来个470场？46岁还在比赛——那为何47岁不行？
这也很酷，还因为阿隆索是凭实力留下的，不仅靠明星光环，更靠表现。他仍然是一位非常出色的F1车手。他永远不会接到顶级车队的召唤——包袱太多，而且近年缺少与一位有实力的队友真实较量的战绩——但他配得上阿斯顿·马丁给他的价值。
我觉得这有点像勒布朗·詹姆斯，但勒布朗每年都能打进NBA季后赛，而阿斯顿·马丁今年的车连附加赛球队都算不上。所以……这其实更像是詹姆斯·米尔纳，对吧？
阿隆索再留一年完全说得通。他已经熬过了最艰难的岁月，而阿斯顿·马丁与本田的合作希望今年就是这段合作的最低谷。
正如他职业生涯中多次见到的那样，在错误的时机离开车队，就有可能眼睁睁看着别人趁虚而入，收割他辛勤付出带来的成果。
为了开上一辆由阿德里安·纽维设计的赛车，他已经等了这么久。他肯定还想要至少一辆，尤其是今年的第一辆在研发概念阶段就被严重掣肘。
纽维的车队能够在底盘方面取得巨大进步——只需看看摩纳哥（A规格）与匈牙利（B规格）之间的相对差距——这将让他对2027年再进一步抱有希望。
所以不要认为相信阿斯顿·马丁明年能拥有前四名之外最好的赛车是不切实际的。
但问题是，它是否拥有一台足够强大的本田动力单元来配得上那台赛车呢？
我认为这对双方来说可能都是正确的结果。是的，阿隆索讨厌2026年的引擎，但他会知道随着2027年和2028年规则调整的到来——以及如果他坚持到更远的未来——最糟糕的阶段已经过去了。
此外，本田明年有巨大的潜力实现大步跃进，因为它将根据国际汽联的ADUO追赶机制获得额外的研发投入，即使这套机制可能会经历改革。
阿隆索目前仍保持着极高的驾驶水准，尽管由于他的队友实力存疑，我们无法准确判断这一水准到底有多高，但可以肯定的是，阿斯顿·马丁和本田眼下要解决的问题远比车手阵容要大得多。
就目前而言，阿隆索已经是这支车队现实中能招到的最高水准的车手了。我想他对此心知肚明，并在谈判中把这一点当作自己的筹码，反复威胁要彻底退出F1。
正如他在阿斯顿·马丁的官方新闻稿中所说，他“非常高兴签下一份新合同”，而不只是延长现有合同，所以我可以想象，他利用了自己对2026年项目进展众所周知的失望情绪，为自己争取到了更好的报酬——与此同时，他不得不思考要在发车榜尾部或附近继续浪费自己F1生涯的暮年时光，至少目前是如此。
阿斯顿·马丁应该考察的是引擎，而不是车手
实际上，他们还能签下谁呢？
斯特罗尔是板上钉钉的，因为他爸爸在出钱。而阿隆索热爱竞争——而且我认为他现在意识到，如果他想继续参赛，已经别无去处。他仍然能做出不错的表现，但我很确定，在50岁之前他是拿不到第三个世界冠军了。
对阿斯顿·马丁来说，把两人都留下，尤其是阿隆索，至少能保持连续性。
现在最大的问题是“他们会不会离开本田？”，如果会，会转投哪家厂商。我觉得大家不妨拭目以待。
费尔南多·阿隆索在一级方程式的长久生涯令人惊叹。他是一位非凡的车手，他的数据并不能完全体现他的实力，而他愿意在这个水平上坚持这么久，承受这一切所带来的种种，无论这是否是正确的决定，都令人敬佩。
到本赛季结束时，他自2021年重返阿尔派开始的“第二段”一级方程式生涯，其时长将等同于2001年至2007年那段时期——那期间他赢得了两个世界冠军，并在他的32场分站冠军中拿下了19场。他的决心令人惊讶，因为尽管他拿到的高额薪水无疑是吸引力的一部分，但要在顶级水平上坚持这么久，需要极大的投入与奉献。
会有人抱怨他占了一个本应属于更年轻车手的席位，或者认为在阿斯顿·马丁这样距离赢分站还相差甚远的车队继续坚持是不切实际的幻想。但这并不是重点。无论你是否是阿隆索的车迷，你都必须尊重这位有史以来最具拼劲的竞争猛兽之一的无限能量。
毕竟，不知道何时放弃正是任何伟大冠军心理构成中的关键要素。
detailEn: A largely fruitless season at Aston Martin-Honda hasn't deterred Fernando Alonso from signing up for another season in Formula 1.
But what can he realistically achieve in 2027 and beyond?
He had to stay. You don't stick around in F1 until your mid-40s to then bow out with a season like this one.

So how much longer does he stay for? To expect Aston Martin to challenge for wins next season would be to expect a miracle. But if the trajectory is right, and the jump in performance is significant, I can see it giving Alonso enough faith to extend into 2028.

I can't imagine that deep down he truly believes another championship is in his future. Aston Martin and Honda getting the jump on everyone in the first year of the new rules was the only chance of that happening, and I always felt that chance was slim.

Now, I reckon the goal is to just do something noteworthy again. Had he won a race among all those podiums during that purple patch in 2023, I think he'd be gone by now. The decision to stick it out for so long would have been justified by just one more win.

I'd be surprised if Aston Martin can be 2023-good again as soon as 2027. But if it can somehow be the team knocking on the door of the big four teams, I can see that being enough to convince Alonso to stay beyond next year.

In principle it's obviously better for Alonso to be in F1 than out of it. But I don't see the point in him wasting his ability and his time when it's for this - so there's massive pressure for Aston Martin and Honda to justify his renewed commitment.

Alonso will be extremely well compensated for his time, of course. So there's a limit to the sympathy his situation is afforded! I'd just rather watch him race somewhere he can be at the front and dazzle us with his talent, because the bad days - like Baku - are just painful for everyone.
But he could well view this as worth one last roll of the dice, especially as he's in a great negotiating position.

You could argue Aston Martin doesn't need a driver of his calibre given the drivers are a long way from being a limiting factor right now. So it makes no meaningful difference to its competitive prospects who is behind the wheel.

But vanity alone is a reason why Aston Martin will want a top name attached to its project and Alonso's the only option in this regard. Nobody else will gamble just now, so Alonso knows there's no real pressure for someone to claim his seat.
That means he can name his price and be there waiting if - and it's a big if - it does actually come together before he finally decides enough's enough and walks away.

From a competitive standpoint, I see little satisfaction in this outcome - Alonso stays at a team (and engine manufacturer) whose timeline for frontrunning seems misaligned with his, whose season has been wholly uninteresting and whose driver pairing is a one-sided contest year after year. We are highly unlikely to learn anything new about Alonso or Stroll in 2027, and Alonso is astronomically unlikely to add to his two F1 titles or, likely, to his 32 F1 wins.

But, unless you're talking about predatory capital accumulation, there is certainly an understandable satisfaction to seeing just how high a number can go. 440 starts - well, why not 470? Racing at 46 - well, why not at 47?

It's quite cool, also because Alonso is sticking around on merit, not just in star power but in performance. He is still a very good F1 driver. He will never get a call to a top F1 team - too much baggage, not enough of a recent record of competition against a credible team-mate - but he is worth his value to Aston Martin.
I'd say it's a bit LeBron James-esque but LeBron makes the NBA playoffs every year, while this year's Aston Martin isn't even a 'play-in' team. So... it's a bit like James Milner, isn't it?
Alonso sticking around for another year makes total sense. He's done the hard yards in what Aston Martin-Honda hopes will be the nadir of the partnership.
As he's seen plenty of times in his career, leaving the team at the wrong time risks letting someone else swoop in and reap the benefits of his hard work.
He's waited this long for an Adrian-Newey-designed car. He'll want at least one more of them, especially when the first this year was so heavily compromised in the conception phase.

The huge improvement Newey's team was able to make with the chassis - just look at the relative difference between Monaco (A-spec) and Hungary (B-spec) - will give him hope of another step forward in 2027.
So don't think it's unrealistic to believe Aston Martin could have the best car outside of the top four next year.
But the question is, will it have a strong enough Honda power unit to do that car justice?

I think this is probably the right outcome for both parties. Yes, Alonso hates the 2026 engines, but he'll know the worst of that is behind him with the rule tweaks coming for 2027 and '28 - and beyond if he gets that far.

Plus, Honda has so much potential to make giant strides forward next year with the extra development spend it's going to get under the FIA's ADUO catch-up mechanism, even if that system undergoes reform.

Alonso's still driving at a very high level and, although we don't know precisely how high that level still is given the questionable pedigree of his team-mate, it's certainly the case that Aston Martin and Honda have far bigger problems to solve right now than the driver line-up.

Alonso is the highest calibre of driver that team can realistically attract right now. I imagine he knew this very well and played it to his advantage during negotiations, repeatedly threatening to quit F1 entirely.

As he said in Aston Martin's press release, he was "very happy to sign a new contract", not simply extend the existing one, so I should imagine he's leveraged his well-documented disappointment with where the project has stood in 2026 to gain better remuneration for himself - while he contemplates having to waste yet more of his twilight F1 career at or near the back of the grid, at least for the time being.
Aston should be scouting engines over drivers
In reality, who else could they get?

Lance is a sure thing because daddy is paying. And Fernando loves the competition - and I think he now realises that if he wants to continue he has nowhere else to go. He can still do a decent job but I’m pretty sure that third world championship won’t come his way this side of 50.
For Aston Martin keeping them both, especially Fernando, at least gives it continuity.
The big question now is ‘will they jump ship from Honda?’, and if so to who. I think watch this space.

Fernando Alonso's F1 longevity is astounding. He's a remarkable driver, one whose statistics don't do his ability justice, but to be willing to plug on at this level for so long with everything that entails is, regardless of whether or not it's the right decision, remarkable.

At the end of this season, his 'second' F1 career after returning with Alpine in 2021 will be as long as the span from 2001-2007 when he won two titles and 19 of his 32 grand prix wins. His determination is astonishing, as while doubtless the large paycheque he receives is part of the appeal, it takes enormous dedication to be able to carry on at the top level for so long.

There will be those who grumble about him taking up a seat that should go to a younger driver, or argue that it's delusional to keep battling on at Aston Martin given how far away it is from being in a position to win races. But that isn't the point. Whether or not you are a fan of Alonso, you must respect the boundless energy of one of the most vigorous competitive beasts who has ever driven a racing car.
After all, not knowing when to quit is a key component of the psychological make-up of any great champion.
keyPointsZh: 如果下赛季阿斯顿·马丁表现提升明显，阿隆索可能因此获得信心将合同延至2028年
编辑认为他内心未必再相信能夺得第三个世界冠军，新规则第一年领先是仅有的机会
若2023年那段高峰期的领奖台中有一次转化为分站冠军，他可能早已退役
keyPointsEn: If Aston Martin's performance jump next season is significant, Alonso could gain enough faith to extend into 2028
The writer believes he no longer truly believes another championship is possible, with the new-rules first year being the only slim chance
If one of his 2023 podiums had become a race win, he might have retired already

items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso extends Aston Martin contract into F1 2027
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso has confirmed he will continue with Aston Martin into the 2027 Formula 1 season, ending all speculation about his future. His previous contract had been due to expire at the end of the 2026 campaign, prompting months of questions.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索将合同延长至F1 2027赛季
这位45岁的车手终于终结了关于其F1未来的猜测
费尔南多·阿隆索终于确认，他将继续效力阿斯顿·马丁征战2027赛季F1，终结了围绕其未来的所有猜测。
由于他与阿斯顿·马丁当时的合同将在2026赛季末到期，这位45岁的车手数月来一直被问及是否会继续留在F1。
这位两届总冠军表示，这取决于规则将朝哪个方向发展，因为他非常不喜欢2026年推出的、更侧重电动动力的新规则体系。
但阿隆索没有公开承诺续约，部分是为了向F1施压，尤其是他此前曾与斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利以及国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆举行过会晤。
于是现在传出了围场早已预期的消息：阿隆索已与阿斯顿·马丁签下新合同，他于2023赛季令人震惊地从阿尔派转投该车队的。
"我非常高兴与阿斯顿·马丁签下新合同，"这位32场分站赛冠军得主说道。"我花了时间来做出这个决定，但赛车是我的生命、我的热情，我知道自己仍然拥有在最高水平竞技的速度和决心。
“我已承诺长期留在这支车队，并帮助我们取得成功。我真心相信我们正在打造的东西：我们有强有力的领导层、出色的人才、合作伙伴和设施。
我期待在赛道上，在热情的车迷面前创造更多回忆。他们的能量营造出一种激励我的氛围，这正是让我们的运动如此特别的原因。
这位西班牙车手在银石车队经历了一段真正起伏不定的旅程：他开局火爆，在最初的八场大奖赛中六次登上领奖台，随后在2023年又两次登台。
但从那以后，低谷成了主旋律，阿斯顿·马丁在研发上被对手超越，随后又在新规则时代开局惨淡，部分原因在于其缺乏竞争力的本田发动机。
15轮比赛过后，阿斯顿·马丁在车队积分榜上排名第十，仅积3分——全部由阿隆索获得，只领先新军凯迪拉克。
这支驻扎在银石的车队还宣布与兰斯·斯特罗尔续约，这意味着这位从威廉姆斯加盟的车手将在银石车队迎来他的第九个赛季。
"我非常高兴能长期继续与阿斯顿·马丁合作，"斯特罗尔说，"我从一开始就参与了这段旅程，我相信我们拥有成为一支获胜车队的资源和人才。
"银石基地正在进行大量艰苦的工作，并且取得了实实在在的进展，我在每个部门看到的决心对我而言是巨大的动力。
费尔南多·阿隆索，阿斯顿·马丁，兰斯·斯特罗尔，阿斯顿·马丁
“我知道我们正朝着正确的方向前进，我帮助车队实现目标的决心比以往任何时候都更强烈。”
车队老板劳伦斯·斯特罗尔补充道：“兰斯和费尔南多一直是我们旅程中至关重要的一部分，我们非常高兴地确认，他们将继续与我们携手迈入车队的下一个篇章。
“拥有两位具备如此经验、投入度和知识水平的车手，为整个组织带来了巨大的价值。
“我们是为了取胜而来，虽然我们的短期重点仍是提升表现，但我相信我们拥有实现长期目标所需的世界级人才。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso extends Aston Martin contract into F1 2027
The 45-year-old has finally ended speculation surrounding his F1 future
Fernando Alonso has finally confirmed that he will continue with Aston Martin into the 2027 Formula 1 campaign, ending all speculation surrounding his future.
For months the 45-year-old had been answering questions about whether or not he will stick with F1, given his then Aston Martin contract expired at the end of the current 2026 campaign.
The double champion claimed it depended on which direction the regulations would take, as he strongly dislikes the new-for-2026 ruleset that has more emphasis on electric power.
But Alonso not publicly committing was partly an effort to increase pressure on F1, particularly as he’d held meetings with Stefano Domenicali and FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem.
So now has come the news that the F1 paddock expected: Alonso has signed a new deal with Aston Martin, who he joined in a shock move from Alpine for the 2023 season.

"I'm very happy to sign a new contract with Aston Martin," said the 32-time race winner. "I took my time to make this decision, but racing is my life, my passion, and I know I still have the speed and determination to compete at the highest level.
"I'm committed for the long term with this team and to helping us succeed. I truly believe in what we are building: we have strong leadership, incredible people, partners and facilities.
"I look forward to making more memories on the racetrack in front of the passionate fans. Their energy creates an atmosphere that inspires me and is what makes our sport special."
The Spaniard has endured a real up-and-down journey with the Silverstone outfit, having made a blistering start with six podiums in his opening eight grands prix before two more in 2023.
But since then it has been mainly lows, as Aston Martin was outdeveloped by its rivals before making a horrendous start to the 2026 regulations, partly due to its uncompetitive Honda engine.
Aston Martin sits 10th in the standings with just three points - all scored by Alonso - after 15 rounds and is only ahead of newcomer Cadillac.
The Silverstone squad has also announced the extension of Lance Stroll's contract, so he is set for his ninth season at Team Silverstone after joining from Williams.

"I'm very happy to continue with Aston Martin for the long term," said Stroll. "I've been on this journey since the beginning and I believe we have the resources and the people to become a winning team.
"There is so much hard work going on at Silverstone with real progress being made, and the determination I see in every department is a huge motivation for me.
Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin, Lance Stroll, Aston Martin
"I know we are heading in the right direction, and my commitment is stronger than ever to help us achieve our goals."
Team owner Lawrence Stroll added: "Lance and Fernando have been a crucial part of our journey and we are very pleased to confirm that they will continue with us into the next chapter for the team.
"Having two drivers with their level of experience, commitment and knowledge provides tremendous value to the whole organisation.
"We are here to win, and whilst our short-term focus remains on improving performance, I believe we have the world-class talent we need to achieve our long-term objectives."
keyPointsZh: 这位45岁的车手此前一直被追问是否会继续留在F1
keyPointsEn: The 45-year-old had been repeatedly answering questions about whether he would stay in F1

items.titleZh: 阿隆索宣布续约阿斯顿·马丁，将征战至2027赛季
items.summaryZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索宣布与阿斯顿·马丁续约，将职业生涯延续至2027赛季。这位2001年出道的车手将迎来第24个全职大奖赛赛季，并继续刷新他所保持的440次F1大奖赛出场纪录。
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso has committed to Aston Martin for the 2027 season, extending his record-breaking Formula 1 career by another year. Having debuted in 2001, he will embark on his 24th full-time season and further extend his record of 440 grand prix starts.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索将把他打破纪录的F1职业生涯再延续一个赛季，确定继续效力阿斯顿·马丁征战2027赛季。
阿隆索于2001年出道，因此将开启他第24个全职大奖赛赛季，并继续扩大他所保持的440次F1大奖赛出场纪录。
“F1一直对我很好，”阿隆索在一段以假退役声明形式发布的2027年续约官宣视频中说道。
“我拥有了一段不可思议的职业生涯。我走遍了世界各地，参加了23年的比赛，超过400场大奖赛。我取得的成就超出了我曾经的一切梦想。”
“我花了一点时间才做出这个决定。但现在我心里已经非常清楚了。
“我将从F1退役……但不是现在。我依然感觉自己速度很快、充满动力，对F1和这项运动怀着巨大的热情。所以，是的，能继续在最高级别的赛事中比赛，我非常高兴。这就是我的生命。”
做出这一决定之际，阿隆索其实在本赛季的大部分时间里都心怀不满、感到失望。尽管阿斯顿·马丁的AMR26赛车令人大失所望，缺乏竞争力且难以驾驭，虽然近期的升级有所改善，但仍然受制于本田动力单元表现不佳，阿隆索却始终坚持表示，他的不满更多是出于对2026年规则的总体不认同，以及对今年比赛形态的不满。
他一直游说各方，希望对2027年规则进行比已经公布的方案更大胆的调整；与此同时，幕后还一直存在一项努力，即为本田提供额外让步，以提升其动力单元的性能。
阿隆索将在下个赛季期间年满47岁。尽管他的职业生涯长度在现代F1中前所未有，但他必须一直参赛到2037赛季，才能成为出发参加F1比赛的最年长车手（该纪录目前由路易斯·希龙保持，他在摩纳哥以55岁高龄出赛）。
detailEn: Fernando Alonso will extend his record-breaking Formula 1 career by another season, committing to Aston Martin for the 2027 campaign.
Alonso, who debuted back in 2001, will thus embark upon his 24th full-time season in grand prix racing - and extend the record for most F1 grand prix starts, which he right now holds with 440.
"F1 has been great to me," said Alonso in a 2027 deal announcement video styled as a fake-out retirement announcement.
"I had an incredible career. I have travelled around the world, I raced for 23 years, more than 400 grands prix. And I achieved more than what I ever dreamed of.
"It took me a little bit of time to make my decision. But now I have things very clear on my mind.
"I will retire from F1...but not yet. I still feel fast and motivated and a huge passion for F1 and for the sport. So, yeah. I'm so happy to keep racing in the highest category. It is my life."

The decision comes despite the fact Alonso has spent much of the season disgruntled and disillusioned. While the Aston Martin AMR26 has been a total letdown, uncompetitive and a handful, improved by a recent upgrade but still hamstrung by the underperformance of the Honda power unit, Alonso has consistently insisted his discontent was more to do with a more general disapproval of the 2026 regulations and the shape of racing this year.

He has lobbied for more aggressive tweaks to the 2027 regulations than what already has been announced, while a behind-the-scenes effort to give Honda extra concessions to improve its power unit performance has also lingered in the background.

Alonso will turn 47 during next season. Though his career longevity is unprecedented in modern F1, he would have to race into the 2037 season to become the oldest driver to start an F1 race (a record currently held by Louis Chiron and his age-55 drive in Monaco).
